LESSON: USE OF MEDICINE

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Health practice
Topic 1.3: Use of medicine

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Use of medicine. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when eye/ear/nose drops) practice cleanliness handling medicine found in when taking the home, medicine?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Use of medicine
2. Practise Use of medicine at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Use of medicine

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Use of medicine
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Use of medicine. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Use of medicine at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Use of medicine at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Use of medicine
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Use of medicine. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Use of medicine using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Use of medicine in the examples.
2. Explain Use of medicine to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Use of medicine.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Use of medicine using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Use of medicine important for a Grade 1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Mention why they should observe cleanliness when taking medicine at home and school.
2. Learners role play precautions and cleanliness when taking medicines.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Use of medicine
2. Practise Use of medicine at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Use of medicine

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
